title: Power BI Weekly Active User Trend
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api
| timechart span=1w dc(user_email) as active_users
| eventstats avg(active_users) as avg_users
| eval below_trend=if(active_users<avg_users*0.85,1,0)
description: Trends the number of distinct weekly active users of Power BI and flags weeks where engagement drops below trend, an early signal of eroding adoption or an access problem.
value: Adoption is the return on a BI investment; a declining active-user trend for Power BI surfaces churn before a renewal or rationalisation review.
implementation: Ingest Power BI usage/activity events; schedule weekly and review adoption dips with the platform owner.
visualization: Timechart of Power BI weekly active users with trend band.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We track how many people actually use Power BI each week so a drop in usage is noticed early.
